messages.body_plain:
Hello Andreas,

I'll just quickly chip in.

I've just ran this within sbuild and I only see one failure. This is as
follows:

> 3. Failure: file_info: can be subset as a tibble (@test-file.R#43)

So, I am not sure why you are getting additional errors...

I did some more investigation on line 43 of tests/testthat/test-file.R.
The class of "x" is of a data frame, and a data frame is made up of
lists (not tibble), which is why this is failing.

Why? Well it seems like line 36 is the culprit, were there is the class
of x being manually set to as a data frame. The patch I will push
momentarily simply swaps the positions of these two tests, and
autopkgtest now passes cleanly for me.

I admit I was under the assumption that anything expressed within it()
is not globalised and is only for that expression.

Kind regards,
Shayan Doust

messages.subject: Any hint for uncompressed JavaScript shipped with mathjaxr
messages.subject_clean: Any hint for uncompressed JavaScript shipped with mathjaxr
messages.body_plain:
Hi Wolfgang,

I intend to package mathjaxr for Debian since this is a requirement of
version 1.4 of metap (currently Debian has version 1.3 of metap).  In
Debian compressed JavaScript is considered as "binary without source"
which violates the Debian Free Software Guidelines where shipping
editable source is a requirement.

The JavaScript files in

    inst/doc/mathjax/es5

seem to be all compressed and I wonder whether you can provide some
hints where to find the uncompressed source for these.

Kind regards

        Andreas.

--

I do not know why the other tests are failing.

fs 1.5.0 is passing on CRAN's debian based check machines without any test failures (https://www.r-project.org/nosvn/R.check/r-devel-linux-x86_64-debian-gcc/fs-00check.html), so if it is failing in the debian build machine there must be something non-standard going on with the environment.

entertain yourself by replicating this with more randomised sets of packages.

    https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team/maintenance-utilities/-/blob/master/r-exclude-doc

Lintian was issuing a warning:

     W: r-cran-poissonbinomial: description-starts-with-leading-spaces

Please make sure the long description starts with exactly one space per
line (not more) since otherwise the text behind lines with more than one
indeting space will considered by several tools as verbose line.

I've fixed this and uploaded.

Kind regards and thanks to Shayan and Steffen for working on this package

      Andreas.

messages.subject: Solved (Was: Any idea why there might be two failures in r-cran-ps autopkgtest)
messages.subject_clean: Solved (Was: Any idea why there might be two failures in r-cran-ps autopkgtest)
messages.body_plain:
On Fri, Sep 11, 2020 at 12:49:34PM +0200, Andreas Tille wrote:
> Backtrace:
>  1. testthat::expect_identical(ps_terminal(p), ps_terminal(me)) test-posix-zombie.R:25:2
>  4. ps::ps_terminal(p)

As the test says it is checking a terminal.  So it was not only xvfb-run missing but
a terminal was needed.  Thus

   /usr/bin/xvfb-run --auto-servernum --server-num=20 -s "-screen 0 1024x768x24 -noreset" xterm  -e /bin/sh -c "R --no-save < $testfile"

finally solved the issue.

Kind regards

     Andreas.
